newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: MRC in talks with buyers for rubber unit.
newsitem.headline: MRC in talks with buyers for rubber unit.

text.p: Industrial estate developer MRC Allied Industries Inc is negotiating with two groups interested in taking over its unprofitable rubber manufacturing subsidiary, an MRC official said on Monday.
"We are talking with a foreign and a local group. We hope to close the deal within this year," MRC's chief operating officer Renato Leveriza told Reuters.
He did not disclose the identities of the groups.
He said the winning group could take over the subsidiary, Makrubber Corp, either through an outright sale or a long-term lease agreement with a profit-sharing scheme.
Makrubber operates two plants in southern Philippines which manufacture rubber vale, the raw material for rubber tyres.
The interested buyers want to transform the plants into major rubber vale producers in southeast Asia, Leveriza said.
Makrubber posted a net loss of about 25 million pesos last year. MRC was a rubber manufacturer until it changed its business to property development in 1995.
